sources.snippet: ☲ Project Nano-Coder (1.5B Agentic) Model Description Project Nano-Coder is a highly compact, agentic AI model fine-tuned exclusively for programming tasks. It is designed to be the smallest, most efficient coding agent possible. Crucially, this model has been intentionally trained to possess ZERO general knowledge.
